entities.summary: Jaap J. Vermeulen is a Dutch botanist, specializing in the Orchidaceae genus Bulbophyllum. Originally a scholar of geology and paleontology, he studied for his PhD in plant taxonomy at the University of Leiden. He has worked at the Singapore Botanic Gardens as a senior research officer and at the National Herbarium of the Netherlands.
